value.rationale: The first odd and next even width-three grids beyond previously computed 4x4 provide natural adjacent parity test cases at square counts 8 and 10. They resolve nine higher-k instances of the 2026 corner-gluing sphere-wedge conjecture by complete finite certificates, and locate the sharp onset of failure of the proposed small-k binomial sphere count at k5 in both grids (deficits 3 and 4). This tests a motivated structural transition rather than an arbitrary graph slice.
